questions.explanation: 结合前半句“Like a rock to a piece of glass”（就像石头砸向玻璃），生动比喻了这句话对作者信念的“摧毁”。ruin 意为“毁坏，摧毁”，符合语境逻辑。establish 建立；restore 恢复；correct 纠正。
questions.supplement:
A(ruined)：语境句：The scandal completely ruined his reputation. 固定搭配：ruin one's health / reputation
B(established)：语境句：The company was established in 1890. 固定搭配：establish a relationship / a rule
C(restored)：语境句：The old church was beautifully restored. 固定搭配：restore one's health / sight
D(corrected)：语境句：He corrected the mistakes in his essay. 固定搭配：correct a mistake / an error

questions.explanation: 由于信念被摧毁，作者的自信心也随之“消退”并消失在黑暗中。fade 意为“逐渐消失，消退”，fade into the blackness 形象表达了自信的丧失。expand 扩大；flow 流动；pour 倾泻。
questions.supplement:
A(faded)：语境句：The sound of the music slowly faded away. 固定搭配：fade away / fade into darkness
B(expanded)：语境句：The business expanded rapidly into new markets. 固定搭配：expand one's business / horizons
C(flowed)：语境句：The river flowed gently into the sea. 固定搭配：flow into / flow through
D(poured)：语境句：She poured a cup of tea for me. 固定搭配：pour out / pour down

questions.explanation: 作者把那些话埋在记忆深处，因为生活用各种任务、目标和成就“取代”了它们。replace A with B 意为“用B替换A”。combine 结合；load 装载；present 呈现。
questions.supplement:
A(combined)：语境句：We combined the two departments to improve efficiency. 固定搭配：combine A with B / combined with
B(loaded)：语境句：The workers loaded the truck with boxes. 固定搭配：load A with B / load up
C(presented)：语境句：He presented the prize to the winner. 固定搭配：present sb with sth / present sth to sb
D(replaced)：语境句：I replaced the old battery with a new one. 固定搭配：replace A with B / replace the broken parts

questions.explanation: 前文说到生活如同日复一日播放的电影般平静，但随后却“出乎意料地”失控了（被查出癌症）。unexpectedly 意为“意外地，出乎意料地”，形成剧情转折。unhurriedly 不慌不忙地；unreasonably 不合理地；unaffectedly 自然地。
questions.supplement:
A(unhurriedly)：语境句：He walked unhurriedly towards the train station. 固定搭配：act unhurriedly / move unhurriedly
B(unexpectedly)：语境句：He arrived unexpectedly in the middle of the night. 固定搭配：happen unexpectedly / die unexpectedly
C(unreasonably)：语境句：She was acting unreasonably about the short delay. 固定搭配：behave unreasonably / complain unreasonably
D(unaffectedly)：语境句：She spoke unaffectedly about her difficult childhood. 固定搭配：behave unaffectedly / smile unaffectedly

questions.explanation: 冒号后的内容“You have cancer.”（你得癌症了）对作者而言是一个突如其来的“消息”。news 意为“消息”。lesson 教训；post 岗位；advice 建议。
questions.supplement:
A(lesson)：语境句：His failure taught him a valuable lesson. 固定搭配：teach sb a lesson / learn a lesson
B(post)：语境句：He resigned from his post as general manager. 固定搭配：take up a post / leave one's post
C(news)：语境句：The news of his sudden death shocked everyone. 固定搭配：break the news / good news
D(advice)：语境句：I decided to follow my doctor's advice. 固定搭配：give advice / take one's advice

questions.explanation: 长达一年经历手术和并发症，这个过程必然是“令人疲惫不堪的，折磨人的”。wearing 意为“使人疲乏的，令人厌烦的”。promising 有希望的；amazing 令人惊叹的；inspiring 鼓舞人心的。
questions.supplement:
A(wearing)：语境句：Taking care of a sick child can be very wearing. 固定搭配：a wearing day / physically wearing
B(promising)：语境句：The young athlete has a promising future. 固定搭配：a promising start / a promising career
C(amazing)：语境句：The view from the top of the mountain was amazing. 固定搭配：an amazing experience / an amazing discovery
D(inspiring)：语境句：Her speech was truly inspiring to all the students. 固定搭配：an inspiring story / an inspiring leader

questions.explanation: 后文提到 mixed with interruptions of relapses（伴随着旧病复发的打断），说明旧病复发之间穿插着的是相对“平静”的时期。calm 意为“平静，安宁”。guilt 内疚；boredom 无聊；shame 羞愧。
questions.supplement:
A(guilt)：语境句：He was consumed by guilt after lying to his friend. 固定搭配：feel guilt / a sense of guilt
B(boredom)：语境句：She complained of boredom during the long holiday. 固定搭配：die of boredom / relieve boredom
C(calm)：语境句：The sea was calm after the violent storm passed. 固定搭配：keep calm / a period of calm
D(shame)：语境句：He hung his head in shame when caught cheating. 固定搭配：feel shame / bring shame on

questions.explanation: 在长达半个世纪的人生斗争中，作者曾多次“回想起”童年时被嘲笑的那些糟糕的话。recall 意为“回想，回忆起”。coin 创造新词；process 加工；spell 拼写/招致。
questions.supplement:
A(coined)：语境句：He coined a new term for this social phenomenon. 固定搭配：coin a word / coin a phrase
B(recalled)：语境句：She recalled seeing him outside the coffee shop. 固定搭配：recall doing sth / recall a memory
C(processed)：语境句：The factory processed raw materials into finished goods. 固定搭配：process data / process food
D(spelled)：语境句：Could you spell your surname for me please? 固定搭配：spell out / spell trouble

questions.explanation: 作者一生都在与癌症以及生活中的挑战作“斗争”。battles 意为“战斗，较量”，契合作者在病痛和逆境中抗争的语境。expectation 期望；dream 梦想；tale 故事。
questions.supplement:
A(expectations)：语境句：The resort exceeded all our holiday expectations. 固定搭配：meet expectations / fall short of expectations
B(dreams)：语境句：She finally realized her childhood dreams. 固定搭配：chase one's dreams / a dream come true
C(tales)：语境句：Grandpa told us fascinating tales of his youth. 固定搭配：tell a tale / fairy tales
D(battles)：语境句：He lost his long battle against lung cancer. 固定搭配：fight a battle / win a battle

questions.explanation: 尽管多次想起那些负面的话，但因为信仰，作者从未让这些话使自己感到“绝望”。hopeless 意为“绝望的”。fearless 无畏的（感情色彩不对，作者希望无畏，不会“不允许自己无畏”）；speechless 无语的；heartless 无情的。
questions.supplement:
A(fearless)：语境句：The fearless firefighter ran into the burning building. 固定搭配：a fearless warrior / absolutely fearless
B(hopeless)：语境句：Without food and water, the situation seemed hopeless. 固定搭配：feel hopeless / a hopeless situation
C(speechless)：语境句：His rude and unexpected behavior left me speechless. 固定搭配：leave sb speechless / be speechless with anger
D(heartless)：语境句：It was a heartless thing to say to a crying child. 固定搭配：a heartless comment / seem heartless

questions.explanation: 生活中的每一个变故都成为一个探索新道路并“提醒”自己有多坚强果断的机会。remind 意为“提醒”。warn 警告；comfort 安慰；question 质疑。
questions.supplement:
A(warn)：语境句：They warned us not to walk alone in the dark alley. 固定搭配：warn sb about sth / warn sb not to do sth
B(comfort)：语境句：She tried to comfort her crying baby with a lullaby. 固定搭配：comfort sb with sth / seek comfort
C(remind)：语境句：Please remind me to call my mother tonight. 固定搭配：remind sb of sth / remind sb to do sth
D(question)：语境句：No one dared to question his final decision. 固定搭配：question one's motives / beyond question

questions.explanation: 朋友问作者：“你是如何坚持下去而不‘放弃’的？”。give up 意为“放弃”，与 keep going 形成对照，符合语义逻辑。get through 熬过；insist on 坚持；hold back 阻挡/克制。
questions.supplement:
A(get through)：语境句：I tried to call you, but I couldn't get through. 固定搭配：get through a difficult time / get through an exam
B(give up)：语境句：No matter how hard it gets, you should never give up. 固定搭配：give up hope / give up doing sth
C(insist on)：语境句：She insisted on paying for the dinner herself. 固定搭配：insist on doing sth / insist on one's rights
D(hold back)：语境句：He tried hard to hold back his tears during the movie. 固定搭配：hold back tears / hold sb back

questions.explanation: 朋友的问题瞬间把作者拉回到了她年轻时的那个“场景”（男孩嘲笑她的那一幕）。scene 意为“情景，场景”。fantasy 幻想；glory 荣耀；adventure 冒险。
questions.supplement:
A(scene)：语境句：The police arrived at the scene of the crime very quickly. 固定搭配：crime scene / behind the scenes
B(fantasy)：语境句：The young boy lived in a beautiful world of fantasy. 固定搭配：fantasy world / childhood fantasy
C(glory)：语境句：The victorious team returned home in a blaze of glory. 固定搭配：bring glory to / bathe in glory
D(adventure)：语境句：They set off on an exciting adventure across the ocean. 固定搭配：a sense of adventure / go on an adventure

questions.explanation: 那句原本伤人的话在作者心中忽然“具有了/蕴含了”新的意义。hold 意为“拥有，蕴含”，hold new meaning 意为“具有新意”。lay 放置；revise 修改；erase 抹去。
questions.supplement:
A(laid)：语境句：She laid the sleeping baby gently on the soft bed. 固定搭配：lay a solid foundation / lay the table
B(revised)：语境句：He revised his manuscript based on the editor's feedback. 固定搭配：revise a plan / revise for an exam
C(erased)：语境句：He erased the wrong answer and wrote the correct one. 固定搭配：erase a memory / erase a mistake
D(held)：语境句：These ancient traditions still hold great significance today. 固定搭配：hold meaning / hold a meeting / hold one's breath

questions.explanation: 首尾呼应，并升华主题：别人问她为何不放弃，她微笑着回答：“我之所以能‘活下来/战胜病魔’，正是因为我像女孩一样去战斗”。survive 意为“幸存，挺过难关”。withdraw 撤退；respond 回应；apologize 道歉。
questions.supplement:
A(withdraw)：语境句：He decided to withdraw from the competition due to injury. 固定搭配：withdraw from / withdraw cash
B(respond)：语境句：The patient didn't respond well to the new medical treatment. 固定搭配：respond to a question / respond quickly
C(survive)：语境句：Only a few people survived the terrible earthquake. 固定搭配：survive a disaster / survive on little money
D(apologize)：语境句：You should apologize to her for being late again. 固定搭配：apologize to sb for sth / sincerely apologize

section_2_word_form.passage:
The Yuxu Palace in Ne Zha 2 fascinates the audience with its delicate colors and structure, paying tribute to (致敬) Emperor Song Huizong's famous painting Ruihe Tu collected in the Liaoning Provincial Museum. Beyond the museum's treasures, Liaoning's culture extends over [56] (century). The Hongshan Culture (4700—2900 BC), discovered in western Liaoning, reveals stone carvings of dragons and phoenixes, suggesting this land brought China's earliest [57] (spirit) symbols into existence. The Three Yan Kingdoms tombs in Chaoyang showcase splendid gold crowns and glassware from the 5th century, [58] (prove) Liaoning was a crossroads of Eurasian civilizations.
Modern Liaoning breathes life into its past. With holographic (全息的) exhibits displaying Nurhaci's rise, visitors walk [59] Manchu-style architecture at the Shenyang Imperial Palace. Meanwhile, the White Pagoda in Liaoyang, built in 1189, stands as a silent guardian of Liao Dynasty Buddhism, whose brick carvings [60] (view) as representation of a bygone era.
Yet at the core of Liaoning's crown jewels [61] (be) its people. Folk artists in villages near Anshan still craft Northeast Tiger paper cuttings, [62] tradition symbolizing courage, [63] chefs in Dalian reinvent royal dishes in the Qing Dynasty. From the whispers of the Liao River to the laughter in Shenyang's night markets, every corner is designed [64] (tell) a story.
As cranes (鹤) rise in both art and reality over Liaoning, [65] they carry is not just beauty but the soul of a civilization that continues to inspire people.

questions.explanation: 句意为“辽宁的文化跨越了几个世纪”。extend over 意为“延续，跨越”，century 此处为可数名词且表示复数概念，故变为复数形式 centuries。
questions.supplement: 正确形(centuries)：语境句：The majestic castle has stood here for centuries. 固定搭配：for centuries, over the centuries。原词century其它变形：centennial(n./adj. 百年纪念/百年的)

questions.explanation: 此处修饰名词 symbols（象征），需将名词 spirit 转化为形容词 spiritual，表示“精神上的（象征）”。
knowledge_points: 词性转换（名词转形容词）
questions.supplement: 正确形(spiritual)：语境句：He traveled to India on a spiritual journey to find himself. 固定搭配：spiritual needs, spiritual leader。原词spirit其它变形：spirited(adj. 精神饱满的), spiritually(adv. 精神上地)

questions.explanation: 本句主语为 The Three Yan Kingdoms tombs，谓语动词为 showcase。逗号后无连词，此处需填非谓语动词。主语 tombs 与 prove 之间为主动关系，且表示顺理成章的自然结果或伴随状况，故使用现在分词 proving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(proving)：语境句：She passed the extremely difficult test, proving her great ability. 固定搭配：prove to be, prove oneself。原词prove其它变形：proof(n. 证据), proven(adj. 已被证实的)

questions.explanation: 句意为“游客们漫步穿梭于沈阳故宫的满族风格建筑中”。walk through 意为“穿行于……”，符合在古建筑群中游览的语境。（填 among 或 around 也可接受）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(through)：语境句：We took a relaxing walk through the beautiful ancient town. 固定搭配：walk through, look through

questions.explanation: 在定语从句 whose brick carvings ___ as representation 中，主语 brick carvings 为复数，与 view 之间为被动关系；且全文叙述的是一种客观事实或现状，应用一般现在时。因此填被动语态 are viewed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are viewed)：语境句：His ambitious actions are viewed as a threat to national security. 固定搭配：view...as, in view of。原词view其它变形：viewer(n. 观众), viewpoint(n. 观点)

questions.explanation: 本句为完全倒装句。表地点的介词短语 At the core of Liaoning's crown jewels 位于句首，其后紧跟系动词，真正的主语是其后的 its people（它的人民）。people 作为集合名词表示复数概念，故系动词填 are。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are)：语境句：At the top of the steep hill are two old pine trees. 固定搭配：be central to, be core to

questions.explanation: 名词短语 tradition symbolizing courage 作前文东北虎剪纸的同位语，表示“（这是）一项象征着勇气的传统”，泛指类别，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：She is a dedicated teacher with ten years of experience. 固定搭配：a lot of, a kind of

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构，前半句讲述鞍山的手工艺人制作剪纸，后半句讲述大连的厨师复原清代宫廷菜，两者是同时发生或并列对比的两项具有地方特色的文化传承活动。填 while（而，然而，同时）最佳；填并列连词 and 也可。
questions.supplement: 正确形(while)：语境句：Some people like to drink tea, while others prefer strong coffee. 固定搭配：for a while, once in a while

questions.explanation: 句意：每一个角落都被设计来讲述一个故事。be designed to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“被设计用来做某事”，不定式表目的。
knowledge_points: 非谓语动词（动词不定式）
questions.supplement: 正确形(to tell)：语境句：The intensive course is designed to help beginners learn coding quickly. 固定搭配：tell a story, tell the truth。原词tell其它变形：telling(adj. 生动的/反映真实情况的), teller(n. 出纳员/讲述者)

questions.explanation: 此处为引导主语从句的连接词，并在从句中作谓语动词 carry 的宾语，意为“它们所承载的事物”。因此填关系代词 what。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：What we desperately need right now is more time and patience. 固定搭配：what if, no matter what
